core_memory.user_introduction_michael: Michael, 35, lives in Seattle, freelance graphic designer, values design aesthetics in gadgets, interested in high-quality coffee machines to enhance his morning routine.
core_memory.user_preference_espresso: Michael prefers espresso machines with sleek, modern designs(especially stainless steel finishes), easy-to-use features for non-professional users, and a café-like experience without requiring barista-level skills.
core_memory.user_inquiry_pricing: Michael is interested in pricing for espresso machines, specifically looking for first-time buyer discounts, new customer offers, and any bundle or limited-time promotions.
core_memory.user_shipping_inquiry: Michael is in Seattle and is concerned about shipping times and origin. He wants to know if products are shipped from a local warehouse, and if not, what the expected delivery time is, especially since he's hosting a family gathering later this month.
core_memory.user_temperature_preference: Michael is concerned about coffee temperature consistency and has had issues with drip coffee makers that don't heat sufficiently, leading him to microwave his coffee. He wants to know if your espresso machines offer adjustable temperature settings or reliably produce hot coffee.
